name: BigCommerce

field_reviews.reason: Single-click apps use the OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant against login.bigcommerce.com/oauth2/token per docs.bigcommerce.com apps auth guide; API accounts doc confirms the OAuth-based account model.

Store-level API accounts issue static access tokens created in the control panel (api_key-style), app-level accounts use the OAuth code grant, and all tokens are passed in the X-Auth-Token header (bearer-token-style usage).

Store-level API accounts can be created self-serve in any store's control panel including free-trial stores, and the Developer Portal (devtools.bigcommerce.com) is free for app-level credentials; a live store (trial or paid) is required, so self_serve_trial is the right value.
REST Admin APIs plus GraphQL Admin and Storefront APIs cover catalog, orders, customers, checkout, carts and webhooks - broad is accurate.
REST and GraphQL confirmed in BigCommerce docs; hosted per-store MCP server confirmed at docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/api-reference/mcp/overview.

The official_vendor_mcp value is correct - the B2C Storefront MCP server is documented on docs.bigcommerce.com with store-specific hosted URLs enabled under Settings > Early access, available since April 28 2026, and the docs MCP server at docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server also exists. However the draft's mcp_notes claim 'GA to all stores since April 2026' is inaccurate: the live docs and the May 7 2026 changelog both label the server Beta, enabled via an Early access opt-in with terms-of-service acceptance, with logged-in flows and the B2B server still 'coming soon'.
Trial store plus self-serve store-level API account allows immediate building; no review gate on API credentials.
No approval, paid-plan or partner gate on core API access; only needing a live store, which self_serve_trial already captures.

notes: Re-checked the vendor MCP claim: BigCommerce Storefront MCP is genuinely official (hosted on docs.bigcommerce.com infrastructure, enabled per store) but is in Beta via Early access opt-in, not GA as the draft's notes stated - field value stands, note corrected. Draft evidence URL docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/api-reference/mcp/overview confirmed live. Auth model (store-level static tokens, app-level OAuth code grant, X-Auth-Token header) re-confirmed. No BigCommerce toolkit in the live Composio catalog (grepped 1183 entries).
